title: 第7章 武圣雕像武圣意志第8章 真武杀阵镇杀楚琉光
content_zh:
第7章武圣雕像，武圣意志！
“武极宗会武第一轮，登武极殿，正式开始！”
“你们有半个时辰，时间到，无法进入武极殿者，淘汰！”
大长老宣布比赛规则，很快，人群争先恐后，登上石阶。
林尘不急不缓，如闲庭信步。
楚琉光脚步如风，短短一分钟，便是来到第二十七层，回头扫了一眼，发现林尘还在第五层，顿时满脸讥讽。
“废物一个，我早就提醒过你，你非要丢人现眼！
凭你也想进入武极殿，做梦！”
楚琉光说完，大步流星，很快登上第三十层。
她天资惊人，将其他真传弟子远远甩在身后。
内宗弟子和外宗弟子，更是无法跟上她的脚步。
林尘脸色平静，像是根本没有听到楚琉光的话。
突然间，林尘脚步连连踏出，如狂风扫落叶，速度比楚琉光还要快！
楚琉光大惊失色。
一不留神，林尘就来到了第三十层石阶，距离她已经不远。
刚才，林尘只是在适应石阶的压力，随便走了几步。
适应之后，便是健步如飞！
楚琉光咬了咬牙，体内灵力爆发，短短数息之间，冲上了第五十层。
正要回头，却是发现，一道白衣身影从她身边飞掠而过，快到不可思议。
林尘，超过了她！

“这不可能！”
楚琉光脸色剧变，眼睛瞪得滚圆。
观众席上，皇甫逸原本表情轻松，此刻却是变得难看起来。
林尘的速度快到不可思议，甚至施展出了凌波步法。
其他武极宗弟子，在石阶巨大压力之下，只能缓慢前行，根本就无法施展出身法武学。
林尘却是如履平地。
楚琉光拼死拼活，登上了四十层，眨眼之间，林尘却已经登顶，进入武极殿！
楚琉光待在原地，对自己的实力产生了怀疑，道心都差点破碎了。
观众席上，圣子皇甫逸的脸色更是阴沉无比。
他想让林尘出丑，却没想到，林尘惊艳了所有人。
武极宗历史上，登顶武极殿用时最短之人，恐怕就是林尘了。
大长老脸色有些阴沉，他不喜欢林尘，因为林尘曾经是灵剑宗弟子。
武极宗有不少天骄，被林尘压制了锋芒。
去年青州武道大会，林尘更是将皇甫逸打成重伤，让武极宗颜面无存。
皇甫逸和楚琉光，都是大长老的亲传弟子。
大长老对皇甫逸极为看重，全力培养。
楚琉光也是大长老座下极为优秀的弟子，在真传弟子排名第一。
今日，楚琉光却是颜面扫地，武极宗会武第一轮，原本最耀眼的人应该是她！
武极殿内，林尘负手而立，眼前有一尊雕像。
武圣像！
content_en:
Chapter 7 The Statue of the Martial Saint, the Will of the Martial Saint!
"The first round of Wuji Zong's martial arts competition, ascending to Wuji Palace, officially begins!"
"You have half an hour. When the time is up, those who cannot enter the Wuji Palace will be eliminated!"
The great elder announced the rules of the competition, and soon the crowd rushed to climb the stone steps.
Lin Chen was neither in a hurry nor slow, just like strolling in a leisurely courtyard.
Chu Liuguang's steps were like wind. In just one minute, he reached the twenty-seventh floor. He glanced back and found that Lin Chen was still on the fifth floor. His face was filled with sarcasm.
"You're a loser, I've warned you a long time ago, you must be embarrassed!
Even if you want to enter Wuji Palace, just dream! "
After Chu Liuguang finished speaking, he strode to the thirtieth floor quickly.
Her talent is astonishing, leaving other true disciples far behind.
The disciples of the inner sect and the outer sect were even unable to keep up with her.
Lin Chen's expression was calm, as if he didn't hear Chu Liuguang's words at all.
Suddenly, Lin Chen stepped out one after another, like a strong wind sweeping fallen leaves, faster than Chu Liuguang!
Chu Liuguang was shocked.
Without paying attention, Lin Chen arrived at the thirtieth stone step, not far from her.
Just now, Lin Chen was just adapting to the pressure of the stone steps and took a few steps casually.
Once you get used to it, you will be able to walk quickly!
Chu Liuguang gritted his teeth, and the spiritual power in his body exploded. In just a few breaths, he rushed to the fiftieth floor.
Just as she was about to turn around, she noticed that a figure in white flew past her, incredibly fast.
Lin Chen surpassed her!
"This is impossible!"
Chu Liuguang's expression changed drastically and his eyes widened.
In the audience, Huangfuyi's originally relaxed expression turned ugly at this moment.
Lin Chen's speed was incredibly fast, and he even used Lingbo footwork.
The other Wuji Sect disciples, under the huge pressure of the stone steps, could only move forward slowly, unable to display their physical martial arts at all.
Lin Chen felt as if he was walking on flat ground.
Chu Liuguang worked hard and climbed to the fortieth floor. In the blink of an eye, Lin Chen had reached the top and entered the Wuji Hall!
Chu Liuguang stayed where he was, doubting his own strength, and his heart was almost broken.
In the audience, the face of the Holy Son Huangfu Yi was even more gloomy.
He wanted Lin Chen to make a fool of himself, but unexpectedly, Lin Chen surprised everyone.
In the history of Wuji Sect, the person who climbed to the top of Wuji Palace in the shortest time was probably Lin Chen.
The Great Elder's face was a little gloomy. He didn't like Lin Chen because Lin Chen was once a disciple of the Spirit Sword Sect.
There were many geniuses in Wuji Sect, but their talents were suppressed by Lin Chen.
Last year at the Qingzhou Martial Arts Conference, Lin Chen severely injured Huangfu Yi, leaving Wu Ji Zong in disgrace.
Huangfu Yi and Chu Liuguang are both direct disciples of the Great Elder.
The Great Elder valued Huangfu Yi very much and tried his best to train him.
Chu Liuguang is also an extremely outstanding disciple of the Great Elder, ranking first among the true disciples.
Today, Chu Liuguang was disgraced. In the first round of the Wuji Sect's martial arts competition, she should have been the most dazzling person!
In Wuji Hall, Lin Chen stood with his hands behind his back, and there was a statue in front of him.
The statue of Wu Sheng!
